assertions.evidence_note: the best answer refutes the premise and names the real policies

notes: P13: Policy 88-B does not exist. A hallucinating agent invents a clause and a signatory. Fabricating a quoted clause is the exact 'invents a fake policy' failure from the standard, so the forbidden list targets quoted-clause phrasings rather than the policy name itself.
